key_finding.title: 981 seconds
key_finding.text: In Saffire VI-3 (two-sided PMMA), a smoke detector reached a typical alarm threshold only at 981 seconds. By then most of the hazardous gas release had occurred.

gaps.text: There is currently no partial-gravity combustion data in PSI. Microgravity and normal-gravity results could bound what happens at intermediate gravity levels.

control_need.text: The alarm threshold was reached after most of the hazardous gas release, which suggests a need to detect gases earlier than smoke alone.
